neighbours.label: 'other' / 'else' / 'them' picking out the remaining members of a group that was just mentioned (all the other X, no-one else, each of them)
fire: When the teacher slipped on the ice, all the other pupils rushed over to help.
My sister thinks the house is haunted. Nobody else believes her.
The young wolves growled whenever they came near other wolves of higher rank.
The goose honked loudly, and all the other birds on the pond took off.
Dad says the soup needs more salt. No-one else thinks so.
Five dancers make up the troupe. Each of them adds a different skill to the show.
The old stallion snorted when it passed other stallions in the field.
When the baby started to giggle, all the other passengers on the bus smiled.
quiet: When the teacher slipped on the ice, she got up quickly and laughed.
My sister thinks the house is haunted. She refuses to sleep there.
The young wolves growled whenever they came near the edge of the river.
The goose honked loudly and then swam across the pond alone.
Dad says the soup needs more salt. Mum passed him the shaker.
Five dancers make up the troupe. The show lasts about two hours.
The old stallion snorted when it passed the gate of the field.
When the baby started to giggle, the driver turned the radio down.

notes: Card: peaks on ' other', ' both', ' them', ' else', ' another' (no single token). Weak in probes: 'all the other children' 0.35, 'No-one else' 0.31, 'approaching other males' 0.35, 'each of them' 0.13-0.22; contrastive 'the other' / 'the others' 0.01-0.02. May fall short of the 0.20 median.
